name: agent-of-record-skills
description: The agent-of-record skill set: approval-gated host command execution, memory and self-improvement, and authoring skills for Claude Cowork on macOS and Windows.

metadata.comment: Source of truth for what ships. Each entry names a directory under CoworkConfig/Skills/. Every skill ships to every product. A skill that duplicates a host capability in some configuration stays in the set and says so in a 'When this skill is redundant' section; the person disables it in the host and re-enables it when the configuration changes (docs/skills-by-configuration.md). The optional products axis remains for a narrower build. All skills are portable: each Windows-specific instruction states its macOS counterpart in the same unit, enforced by scripts/build_plugin.py --strict. The list lives under metadata because Claude Code reads the top-level `skills` field as component paths and fails to load a manifest whose `skills` is not a path; `metadata` is the free-form object the schema reserves for a plugin's own data. The skills/ tree beside this file is generated from CoworkConfig/Skills by scripts/build_plugin.py --tree; the release gate fails when it is stale.
